atoms.a: It is estimated that <mat>57%</mat> of British households own a pet. What is <mat>57%</mat> as a decimal number?

It is estimated that 12 million dogs live in households in the UK, which makes dogs the most popular pet among Brits. <mat>31%</mat> of UK households own a dog. What is <mat>31%</mat> as a decimal number?
Cats are the second most popular pet in the UK. About <mat>26%</mat> of households own a cat. What is <mat>26%</mat> as a decimal number?
Reptiles are not very popular pets. For example, only <mat>1.8%</mat> of households in the UK have a reptile as a pet. What decimal number represents the percentage of UK households with reptiles?
In the US, you will find the most pets in rural areas. In Wyoming, for example, <mat>78%</mat> of all households own at least one pet. What is <mat>78%</mat> as a decimal number?
In New Zealand, the portion of households that own a pet fish is 0.09. What is 0.09 in percent?
In Australia, there are more pets than people. About 29 million pets live on the continent, however, the portion of Australian households that own a pet is only 0.61. What is 0.61 in percent?
Japan has a very low number of pets per household. In fact, Japan has the lowest portion of pets worldwide with 0.72 households not owning a pet at all. What is 0.72 in percent?

<mat>3/4</mat> of all people owning a cat consider it to be a family member. This number is only higher for dog owners. <mat>85%</mat> of households with a dog see their dog as a family member. What percentage represents the people that consider their cat to be a family member?
While <mat>34%</mat> of dogs come from breeders, only 3 in 100 cats come from a breeder. What percentage represents the amount of cats that come from breeders?
